# Tyrand — Deep Tech Software Agency

Tyrand is a premier Helsinki-based software engineering agency specializing in deep tech, AI automation, CRM/POS systems, SaaS platforms, and enterprise digital solutions. We engineer complex, scalable digital products for startups and enterprises worldwide.

## Core Services
- Custom Software Development
- AI Chatbot Development & AI Related Services
- UI/UX Architecture & Design
- SaaS Platform Engineering
- CRM & POS System Development
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
- SEO & Digital Marketing Services

## Industries Served
- FinTech & Banking (Blockchain, DeFi, PCI-DSS compliance)
- HealthTech & MedTech (HIPAA compliance, IoT medical devices)
- SaaS Platforms (Microservices, Kubernetes)
- E-Commerce (Headless commerce, AI recommendation engines)
- Logistics & Supply Chain (Real-time tracking, algorithmic routing)
